Barbarian.name: Barbaric Whirl
Barbarian.descriptionEn:
Requires Melee Weapon
Whirl in a barbaric fury, striking up to 5 nearby enemies with both weapons, dealing 135% Weapon Damage plus 3.
Barbarian.descriptionEs:
Requiere arma cuerpo a cuerpo
Gira con furia bárbara, golpeando hasta a 5 enemigos cercanos con ambas armas, infligiendo un 135% de daño de arma más 3.

Barbarian.name: Impaling Rush
Barbarian.descriptionEn:
Increases your movement speed by 40% for 5 sec. 
Your next attack within the duration will consume the effect to impale your target, causing them to Bleed for 40 Physical damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.
Barbarian.descriptionEs:
Aumenta tu velocidad de movimiento un 40% durante 5 s. 
Tu siguiente ataque dentro de la duración consumirá el efecto para empalar al objetivo, haciéndolo sangrar por 40 p. de daño físico cada 1 s durante 6 s.

Barbarian.name: Excessive Power
Barbarian.descriptionEn: Increases your maximum Energy by 100%.
Barbarian.descriptionEs: Aumenta tu Energía máxima un 100%.

Barbarian.name: Headhunting
Barbarian.descriptionEn: Reduces the cast time of Throw Weapon by 20% and removes your spell pushback suffered from taking damage.
Barbarian.descriptionEs: Reduce el tiempo de lanzamiento de Throw Weapon un 20% y elimina el retroceso de hechizos al recibir daño.

Barbarian.name: Fill Level
Barbarian.descriptionEn:
Grants Fill Level and the ability to manipulate a Tankard.
 Fill Level 
 You have a magical Tankard that fills up over time, granting you 1 stack of Fill Level every 2 sec.
Some of your other abilities empty your Tankard to trigger with a reduced cooldown.
Barbarian.descriptionEs:
Otorga Fill Level y la habilidad de manipular un Tankard.
 Fill Level 
 Tienes un Tankard mágico que se llena con el tiempo, otorgándote 1 acumulación de Fill Level cada 2 s.
Algunas de tus otras habilidades vacían tu Tankard para activarse con un tiempo de reutilización reducido.

Barbarian.name: Brutal Swing
Barbarian.descriptionEn:
Requires Melee Weapon
Your next attack causes you to swing violently at an enemy and up to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 135% Weapon Damage plus 10.
Barbarian.descriptionEs:
Requiere arma cuerpo a cuerpo
Tu siguiente ataque te hace golpear violentamente a un enemigo y hasta 2 enemigos cercanos, infligiendo un 135% de daño de arma más 10.

Barbarian.name: Ripper
Barbarian.descriptionEn:
Requires One-Handed Melee Weapon
Strike an enemy for Weapon Damage plus 1 with both weapons and grants Ripping Frenzy.
 Ripping Frenzy 
 Melee attack speed increased by 2%, stacking 8 times, for 8 sec.
Upon reaching 8 stacks, Ripper will go on cooldown for 20 seconds.
Barbarian.descriptionEs:
Requiere arma de una mano Melee Weapon
Strike an enemy for Weapon Damage plus 1 with both weapons and grants Ripping Frenzy.
 Ripping Frenzy 
 Melee attack speed increased by 2%, stacking 8 times, durante 8 s.
Upon reaching 8 stacks, Ripper will go on tiempo de reutilización durante 20 sonds.

Starcaller.name: Slipstream
Starcaller.descriptionEn:
You liquify your physical form into a pool of healing water for 5 sec, making you unable to act but healing nearby allies for 7+(PL*0.6-11*0.6) every 1 sec.
Each tick consumes 1 stack of Bathe on affected allies to do additional healing for each stack.
This effect also increases your movement speed by 40% and reduces your damage taken by 20%.

You liquify your Físico form into a pool of healing water durante 5 s, making you unable to act but healing nearby allies for 7+(PL*0.6-11*0.6) cada 1 s.

Runemaster.descriptionEs: Regenerates 20% maximum Maná and Reduce el daño recibido un 10% durante 8 s.

Runemaster.name: Prismatic Blade
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Strike an enemy for Weapon Damage plus 2 as Arcane, and cycle your Attunement twice.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Strike an enemy for Weapon Damage plus 2 as Arcane, and cycle your Attunement twice.

Runemaster.name: Runed Cascade
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Blast up to 10 enemies within 8 yds of the enemy target for 133 Spellfire Damage, and applies Spellwrath to all affected enemies.
Always applies the maximum amount of Spellwrath stacks.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Blast up to 10 enemies within 8 yds of the enemy target for 133 Spelldaño de Fuego, and applies Spellwrath to all affected enemies.
Always applies the maximum amount of Spellwrath stacks.

Runemaster.name: Prismatic Knight
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Increases your Armor by 100% of your Intellect and reduces damage done by 0%.
Parrying an attack generates an Inscribed Rune and increases your Melee Attack Speed by 10% for 12 sec.
Active while using a Two-Handed Melee Weapon.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Increases your Armor by 100% of your Intellect and reduces damage done by 0%.
Parrying an attack generates an Inscribed Rune and increases your Melee Attack Speed by 10% durante 12 s.
Active while using a Two-Handed Melee Weapon.

Runemaster.name: Aspect of The Rune Knight
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Reduces damage you take by 10%, increases maximum mana by 20%.
Only 1 Aspect can be active at a time.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Reduces damage you take by 10%, increases maximum Maná by 20%.
Only 1 Aspect can be active at a time.

Runemaster.name: Runefeed
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Remove 1 curse from an ally.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Remove 1 curse from an ally.

Runemaster.name: Warding Rune
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Engrave anti-magic runes around you, removing all harmful magic effects and causing harmful magic effects to have no duration when cast on you for 6 sec.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Engrave anti-magic runes around you, removing all harmful magic effects and causing harmful magic effects to have no duration when cast on you durante 6 s.

Runemaster.name: Master of Runes
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of your Rune spells by 25%.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Reduces the tiempo de reutilización of your Rune spells by 25%.

Runemaster.name: Thaumaturgy
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Blast an enemy for 67+0+ArcP*.41+AP*0.1 Arcane damage and unleash your active Glyph effect.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Blast an enemy for 67+0+ArcP*.41+AP*0.1 daño Arcano and unleash your active Glyph effect.

Runemaster.name: Scrying Orb
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Conjure a Scrying Orb for 1 min that you can control directly and see through.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Conjure a Scrying Orb for 1 min that you can control directly and see through.

Runemaster.name: Palm Sigil: Arcane
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Engrave an arcane rune into your palm, causing your next instance of direct Magic damage within 6 sec to deal an additional 5% of the damage dealt as Arcane damage every 3 sec for 12 sec and silences the target for 3 sec.
Usable while moving.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Engrave an arcane rune into your palm, causing your next instance of direct Magic damage within 6 sec to deal an additional 5% of the damage dealt as daño Arcano cada 3 s durante 12 s and silences the target durante 3 s.
Usable while moving.

Runemaster.name: Palm Sigil: Frost
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Engrave a frost rune into your palm, causing your next instance of direct Magic damage within 6 sec to deal 30% of the damage dealt as Frost damage and slow the enemy's movement speed by 70% for 8 sec. 
Usable while moving.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Engrave a frost rune into your palm, causing your next instance of direct Magic damage within 6 sec to deal 30% of the damage dealt as daño de Escarcha and slow the enemy's movement speed by 70% durante 8 s. 
Usable while moving.

Runemaster.name: Palm Sigil: Earth
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Engrave an earth rune into your palm, causing your next instance of direct Magic damage within 6 sec to stun a target enemy for 4 sec.
Usable while moving.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Engrave an earth rune into your palm, causing your next instance of direct Magic damage within 6 sec to stun a target enemy durante 4 s.
Usable while moving.

Runemaster.name: Shrouded Hand
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Teaches you Imbue Flame, Imbue Frost, and Imbue Arcane.
These 3 spells share a cooldown, and are only usable during Runeshroud. 
They each generate 1 Sigil of their respective type and activate the matching Attunement.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Teaches you Imbue Flame, Imbue Frost, and Imbue Arcane.
These 3 spells share a tiempo de reutilización, and are only usable during Runeshroud. 
They each generate 1 Sigil of their respective type and activate the matching Attunement.

Runemaster.name: Leyline Rider
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Warplink and Warp Shift by 20%.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Reduces the tiempo de reutilización of Warplink and Warp Shift by 20%.

Runemaster.name: Trap Runes
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Etch a Trap Rune onto a surface for up to 5 min. 
Learning this spell teaches you 3 Trap Glyphs you can carve onto the Trap Runes which determine what happens when an enemy activates them.
You cannot place multiple Trap Runes within 10 yds of eachother.
 Traprune: Blasting Glyph 
 Apply the Blasting Glyph effect to a Traprune, causing it to blast the enemy that triggers it, dealing Arcane Damage and knocking them away from it.
 Traprune: Stunning Glyph 
 Apply the Stunning Glyph effect to a Traprune, causing it to stun the enemy that triggers it for 4 sec.
 Traprune: Unmaking Glyph 
 Apply the Unmaking Glyph effect to a Traprune, applying a damage over time effect to the enemy that triggers it and increase the critical strike chance of spells cast against them by 8% for 12 sec.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Etch a Trap Rune onto a surface for up to 5 min.

Runemaster.name: Ley Focus
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Enter a state of supreme Focus, increasing spell haste by 60% and spell critical strike chance by 40%.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Enter a state of supreme Focus, increasing spell haste by 60% and spell critical strike chance by 40%.

Runemaster.name: Phase Rush
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Casting Thaumaturgy now grants you 25% increased movement speed for 5 sec.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Casting Thaumaturgy now grants you 25% increased movement speed durante 5 s.

Runemaster.name: Steam Conjurer
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Damage dealt by Weapon Engraving: Earth now has a 5% chance to cast Wild Steam. Can only occur once every 3 sec.
 Wild Steam 
 Stomp the ground in a 8 yd radius around you and release steam, dealing 128*$+AP*.25 Frostfire Damage to nearby enemies.
Runemaster.descriptionEs:
Damage dealt by Weapon Engraving: Earth now has a 5% chance to cast Wild Steam. Can only occur once cada 3 s.
 Wild Steam 
 Stomp the ground in a 8 yd radius around you and release steam, dealing 128*$+AP*.25 Frostdaño de Fuego to nearby enemies.

Runemaster.name: Wind Surge
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Your Weapon Engraving: Air will now strike 2 additional enemies near its target.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Your Weapon Engraving: Air will now strike 2 additional enemies near its target.

Runemaster.name: Evasive
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Twilight Frenzy now grants you 20% reduced damage taken while active.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Twilight Frenzy now grants you 20% reduced damage taken while active.

Runemaster.name: Alertness
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Reduces the duration of any stun or snare effects used on you by 20% and increases your dodge chance by 5%.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Reduces the duration of any stun or snare effects used on you by 20% and increases your dodge chance by 5%.

Runemaster.name: Runic Obliteration
Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Hurl powerful elemental missiles at an enemy, dealing 250+1.5 Points Per Level+SP*0.44 Elemental Damage every 0.3 sec for 1 sec. Each missile grants you a Glyph.
Scales with modifiers to Primordial Blast.

Hurl powerful elemental missiles at an enemy, dealing 250+1.5 Points Per Level+SP*0.44 Elemental Damage every 0.3 sec durante 1 s. Each missile grants you a Glyph.

Runemaster.name: Runic Quickness
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Word spells now activate 25% faster.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Word spells now activate 25% faster.

Runemaster.name: Fists of Power
Runemaster.descriptionEn: Engrave your fists for 15 sec, causing auto attacks to grant Earthen Fists for 10 sec, increasing melee haste by 3% and the chance to trigger Weapon Engraving: Earth by 10%, stacking 5 times.
Runemaster.descriptionEs: Engrave your fists durante 15 s, causing auto attacks to grant Earthen Fists durante 10 s, increasing melee haste by 3% and the chance to trigger Weapon Engraving: Earth by 10%, stacking 5 times.

Runemaster.descriptionEn:
Consumes 1 Inscribed Rune
Reduces the Cooldown of your next Familiar spell by 33%, or the Cast Time of your next Conjure: Runic Familiar by 25%. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
